cards.design_implication: If the study objective involves modeling actin network stability, consider incorporating actin turnover as a primary variable to tune stress levels and stabilize homogeneous morphologies.
does_not_establish: In vivo biological mechanisms independent of the model
Specific experimental protocols for inducing turnover
cards.evidence_excerpt: In particular, actin turnover dynamics plays a prominent role in tuning stress levels and stabilizing homogeneous morphologies in crosslinked, motor-driven networks.
limitations: The claim is based on a computational model (Brownian dynamics) rather than empirical biological data.
The role of turnover is specific to crosslinked, motor-driven networks as defined by the model parameters.
cards.statement: In a Brownian dynamics model of the actin cytoskeleton, actin turnover dynamics plays a prominent role in tuning stress levels and stabilizing homogeneous morphologies.
